annotations.text:
A is the working prototype, now in the style of a 1980s vacuum-fluorescent dashboard (Corvette C4 / 300ZX): a 40-segment bar-graph gauge lit to the saving rate, a blinking red segment at the required rate, a small marker at the earning rate, dot-matrix numerals with unlit ghost digits behind, and a segmented arrival timeline. Tweaks above the frame switch phosphor color (cyan / green / amber) and the clocked-in state; the button logs a ¥50k boost.
D is a rough alternate: the same layout as a monochrome calculator LCD. Same numbers everywhere: 手取り 35万, spend 20万, 160h/month, ¥4.2M saved, FIRE ¥30M by 2040-01. Investment returns are not modeled yet.
